test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

A selected group of activists had been invited by the minister before the announcement of the strike.

options.text: The minister was inviting a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike
The minister had been inviting a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike
The minister invited a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike.
The minister had invited a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action expressed by the verb.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "A selected group of activists had been invited by the minister before the announcement of the strike."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the original subject "the minister" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "had been invited" to "had invited" (past perfect active).
 
• Ensure the object "a selected group of activists" follows the verb, maintaining the time phrase "before the announcement of the strike."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The minister had invited a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "The minister was inviting a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike." – Incorrect tense (past continuous).
 
• **Option 2:** "The minister had been inviting a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike." – Incorrect aspect (past perfect continuous).
 
• **Option 3:** "The minister invited a selected group of activists before the announcement of the strike." – Incorrect tense (past simple instead of past perfect).
